_reads: `tables` names every TOML table the take reads out of a manifest and then removes, because a table read out of a tree and left standing in it is a second answer to the same question. Their marker and workspace tables are read only when the manifest declares a workspace, since that is the shape whose meaning differs at a crate root.
_comment: The single rule face every taken tree is filtered by on the way in, however many trees are declared. No entry has an exception and no entry has a depth limit: a rule that matched only at the top would leave a second answer further down, and a second answer is the same thing as a second graph wherever it sits.
_predicate: A taken tree carries static source and nothing that can speak for itself. What speaks for itself is a version-control entry point, a build root, a package-manager root, or a generated artifact. A crate's `Cargo.toml` and a package's `package.json` are identity cards and stay; any workspace table inside either is removed on the way in, because a workspace table is a graph root rather than an identity.
